characters.name: Naruto Uzumaki
characters.description: A loud, determined young ninja of Konoha who dreams of becoming Hokage and winning the respect of the whole village.

characters.name: Sasuke Uchiha
characters.description: Naruto's gifted teammate and rival from the Uchiha clan, a cool and serious ninja driven by a personal goal.

characters.name: Sakura Haruno
characters.description: Naruto's teammate on Team 7, clever and short-tempered, with remarkable chakra control.

characters.name: Kakashi Hatake
characters.description: The relaxed leader of Team 7, a veteran jonin famous for copying techniques and for the mask that covers his face.

characters.name: Iruka Umino
characters.description: A caring academy teacher who believes in Naruto from the start and acts like an older brother to him.

characters.name: Hiruzen Sarutobi
characters.description: The elderly Third Hokage, a wise and respected leader of Konoha known for an enormous range of jutsu.

characters.name: Konohamaru Sarutobi
characters.description: A mischievous young boy who admires Naruto and has his own dream of becoming Hokage.

characters.name: Jiraiya
characters.description: One of the legendary Sannin, a perverted but powerful toad-summoning ninja who takes Naruto on as a student.

characters.name: Tsunade Senju
characters.description: A legendary Sannin and the greatest medical ninja of her time, famous for her monstrous strength and bad luck at gambling.

characters.name: Orochimaru
characters.description: A rogue Sannin and wanted criminal who experiments with forbidden jutsu and schemes against Konoha.

characters.name: Itachi Uchiha
characters.description: Sasuke's older brother, a feared prodigy and Akatsuki member whose Sharingan makes him a looming threat.

characters.name: Kisame Hoshigaki
characters.description: An Akatsuki swordsman and Itachi's partner, a shark-like missing ninja of the Mist who wields the huge blade Samehada.

characters.name: Gaara
characters.description: A ninja of the Hidden Sand who commands sand from a gourd, with an unsettling calm and frightening power.

characters.name: Rock Lee
characters.description: A Leaf ninja who cannot use ninjutsu or genjutsu yet trains relentlessly in taijutsu, idolizing his teacher Guy.

characters.name: Neji Hyuga
characters.description: A prodigy of the Hyuga clan who wields the Byakugan and firmly believes that people cannot escape their destiny.

characters.name: Hinata Hyuga
characters.description: A shy and kind Hyuga clan ninja with the Byakugan who draws strength from watching Naruto never give up.

characters.name: Shikamaru Nara
characters.description: A lazy but brilliant strategist of the Nara clan who fights with shadow techniques and dislikes effort.

characters.name: Might Guy
characters.description: An energetic taijutsu master and the teacher of Team Guy, devoted to hard work and the spirit of youth.

characters.name: Zabuza Momochi
characters.description: A missing ninja of the Mist called the Demon of the Hidden Mist, armed with an enormous cleaver-like sword.

characters.name: Haku
characters.description: A quiet young ninja who serves Zabuza and has a rare ice-based bloodline ability.

characters.name: Kabuto Yakushi
characters.description: A friendly, well-informed ninja met at the Chunin Exams who happily gives advice to the rookies.

characters.name: Kurama
characters.description: The giant Nine-Tailed fox sealed inside Naruto, a being of vast chakra that resents its captivity.

characters.name: Killer Bee
characters.description: A rap-loving ninja of the Hidden Cloud and brother of the Raikage, who fights with swords and hides a Tailed Beast.

characters.name: Nagato
characters.description: The man behind the Akatsuki leader known as Pain, a gentle soul scarred by war who controls six bodies.

characters.name: Minato Namikaze
characters.description: Konoha's Fourth Hokage, called the Yellow Flash, a master of speed and sealing who is Naruto's father.

characters.name: Madara Uchiha
characters.description: A legendary Uchiha, once the First Hokage's great rival, revived to join the huge war between the shinobi nations.

characters.name: Obito Uchiha
characters.description: A member of Kakashi's old team thought lost long ago, later revealed as the masked man steering the Akatsuki.

characters.name: Kaguya Otsutsuki
characters.description: An ancient Otsutsuki princess whose hunger for power threatens all humanity and drives the final conflict.

characters.name: Boruto Uzumaki
characters.description: Naruto's son, a bright and rebellious young ninja of the next generation who leads his own small team.

characters.name: Sarada Uchiha
characters.description: Sasuke and Sakura's daughter, a determined young ninja who dreams of becoming Hokage herself.
